findings.requirement: F-S15 envelopes and L-O02 normalized witness envelope
findings.defect: Stores verified.observation as statement and compares only that observation. Store the complete parseJournalWitness result as statement and its complete canonical text. All later events/status/closure consumers require the whole normalized journal-witness envelope, including id/core/sources. Preserve original verified statement/source-array values separately.

findings.requirement: F-S15 and L-O25 unchanged-history verification reuse
findings.defect: Every refresh re-runs parseJournalWitness and verifyArtifact for every cached body, then re-addresses all cached unique commands. Cache the per-source verified correspondences alongside parsed results, reuse them only for exact identity/kind/size/digest matches, and reconstruct current custody/membership/conflict maps from those already verified pairs without re-verifying unrelated unchanged bodies. Verify newly seen/changed records fully before delivering only unseen pairs to the existing substrate. No second scanner or evaluator.

Returns Map<event,Map<canonicalText,value>> instead of Map<event,array of original JSON values>. Finalize each event to canonical-text-sorted exact-deduplicated arrays, preserving null/false/bodyless decisions. Keep any temporary decision maps private; use the same exact current decisions for reconstruction and reuse classification. Remove unused retainedDecisionPairs/retained variables.

findings.requirement: F-S15 unique parser correspondence; existing parser owns slot law
findings.defect: Reimplements the slot hash from untrusted optional command fields. After exact canonical bytes are admitted, call parseUniqueJournalRecord(admitted.value, configuration.journal, filenameDigest) directly; it verifies the slot and entire record. Remove duplicate slot hashing/extraction, preserving unique whole-record capacity and command-body custody.

findings.requirement: F-S15 safe mutable cache update and L-O25 current-source equivalence
findings.function: refreshSourceView monotone branch and final binding checks
findings.defect: receiveSourceSet mutates prior.view.substrate while operation.cache.value still points at old source metadata. If receive throws or later assertLive/assertBindings fails, the old cache remains with a mutated judgment. Invalidate the cache before any mutable receive, or use a failure guard covering every later operation through cache commit. Install a new cache only after final checks; preserve the primary diagnostic and leave no partially updated judgment reusable.

findings.requirement: L-O23 retained transport envelope and unchanged inner artifact limits
findings.defect: canonicalJson(normalized, JSON_RESOURCE_ENVELOPE) imposes artifact depth/size bounds on an observation/envelope whose retained transport was admitted under line capacity. Canonicalize the complete verified envelope with the retained line-derived envelope (or the already admitted transport bounds); keep fixed envelopes on actual inner artifacts, retained decision values, and unique whole records. Valid deep permitted observation metadata must survive. Wrap newly computed semantic/correspondence failures in the closed source diagnostics so raw codec errors do not escape the owner.
